title: Segfault on playing an `AnimationPlayer` capture track with invalid target
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible on windows v4.8.dev.gh.9c776068d as well as windows 4.7.1 release


### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (9c776068d) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+)

### Issue description

If an animation on an `AnimationPlayer` has a capture track with a track path that points to a node that doesn't exist, running the animation will segfault.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create an `AnimationPlayer` node
- Add a property track to manipulate some property, add a key to it that's not at 0 seconds
- Change the track type to capture mode
- Edit the track path, or change the node path, to make it point to an invalid node
- Play the animation, either through code or in the editor
